rules.title: Reinsure only with a company licensed to carry the class
rules.instrument: Article (42) — Federal Decree-Law No. 48 of 2023 Regulating Insurance Activities
rules.note: replaced by Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 from 16 September 2025, with a transition to 16 September 2026
rules.clause: Article (42): The Company may not reinsure with another company unless the other company is licensed to carry out the insurance type entrusted to reinsure it.
rules.requirement: The counterparty must be licensed for the class of business ceded — a UAE licence, or a home-state licence naming the class for a reinsurer abroad. A UAE carrier may reinsure inside or outside the State, but never with an unlicensed company.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز للشركة أن تعيد التأمين لدى شركة أخرى ما لم تكن تلك الشركة مرخصة لمزاولة نوع التأمين المطلوب إعادة تأمينه.

rules.title: A counterparty at or above the rating floor, or board diligence on file
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: Article (18): acceptance of reinsurance business is conditional on the reinsurer meeting the classification stipulated, and business exceeding retention must be covered with reinsurers who have that classification, subject to the stated exceptions.
rules.requirement: A reinsurance counterparty should hold a financial strength rating of BBB (S&P) or equivalent — Baa2 or better — or, if it does not, the placement needs documented board-level due diligence before it is bound.
rules.requirementAr: يُشترط في شركة إعادة التأمين الحصول على تصنيف مالي لا يقل عن BBB أو ما يعادله، وإلا وجب توثيق العناية الواجبة على مستوى مجلس الإدارة.

rules.title: Recoverables count as admissible assets only at or above the floor
rules.instrument: Minimum capital requirement — CBUAE financial regulations — capital, assets and technical provisions
rules.clause: Assets available to meet insurance liabilities may include reinsurance recoverables where the reinsurer is rated BBB or better.
rules.requirement: Money due from a counterparty below the floor is not an admissible asset: the return must show the recoverable without credit for it, and the solvency position must be read with that in mind.
rules.requirementAr: لا تُعد المبالغ المستحقة من معيد تأمين دون التصنيف المطلوب أصولاً مقبولة، ويجب بيانها دون احتساب رصيد لها.

rules.title: Every cession sits inside the board-approved retention and reinsurance plan
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: The company shall prepare a three-year plan concerning retention and reinsurance for each type and class, approve it at the board, and review it annually during the three months before each year, covering retention and treaty limits, treaty types and facultative cessions.
rules.requirement: A cession must be permitted by the plan the board approved, and the plan must have been reviewed inside the year before the placement. A cession outside the plan is refused; a plan whose review window has passed is escalated.
rules.requirementAr: يجب أن تكون إعادة التأمين ضمن الخطة المعتمدة من مجلس الإدارة، وأن تُراجع الخطة سنوياً خلال الأشهر الثلاثة السابقة لكل سنة.
evidence: board minute of the annual review

rules.title: A foreign branch files its head-office reinsurance certificate every year
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: A foreign insurance company operating in the State through a branch shall annually submit a certified certificate from its head office supporting that the business subscribed within the State and exceeding its retention is covered by reinsurance with reinsurers who have the classification stipulated in Article (18).
rules.requirement: Where the counterparty is the branch of a foreign company, its annual certified certificate must be on file and no more than twelve months old.
rules.requirementAr: على فرع شركة التأمين الأجنبية العاملة في الدولة أن يقدم سنوياً شهادة معتمدة من المركز الرئيسي تفيد بأن الأعمال التي تتجاوز حد الاحتفاظ مغطاة لدى معيدي تأمين حاصلين على التصنيف المطلوب.

rules.title: Accepting treaty reinsurance needs approval and capital
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: Article (39): in order to accept the treaty reinsurance business, the insurance company established in the State is required to obtain approval from the Director General, and the minimum subscribed and paid-up capital of the company shall not be less than AED 350,000,000.
rules.requirement: Inward treaty business may only be accepted with the Director General's approval, articles that authorise accepting reinsurance, and at least AED 350,000,000 of subscribed and paid-up capital.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز قبول أعمال إعادة التأمين الاتفاقي إلا بعد الحصول على موافقة المدير العام، وبألا يقل رأس المال المكتتب المدفوع عن 350,000,000 درهم.

rules.title: Facultative acceptance only within retention or under a treaty
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: Article (38): the accepted liabilities shall be either within the company's retention or exceeding it, in which case the company must have a reinsurance treaty that protects the surplus and contains a provision allowing it to accept facultative reinsurance within determined limits; re-ceding that surplus facultatively needs the prior approval of the ceding company.
rules.requirement: Facultative business may be accepted only inside the retention or under a treaty that protects the surplus and permits facultative acceptance; passing the surplus on needs the ceding company's prior approval.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز قبول أعمال إعادة التأمين الاختياري إلا في حدود حد الاحتفاظ أو في وجود اتفاقية تحمي الفائض وتجيز القبول، مع الحصول على موافقة مسبقة من الشركة المتنازلة عند إعادة التنازل.

rules.title: A tender is only offered with a leading reinsurer behind the surplus
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: Article (31): the company shall obtain approval, before submitting its offer, from a leading reinsurer that meets the conditions stipulated in Article (18), where the tender's cover is one for which the company has no reinsurance treaty covering the surplus above its retention.
rules.requirement: Where a tender is not covered by treaty, written approval from a leading reinsurer that meets the classification requirement must be on file before the offer goes in.
rules.requirementAr: يجب الحصول على موافقة من معيد تأمين رائد يستوفي شروط المادة (18) قبل تقديم العرض إذا لم تكن تغطية المناقصة مشمولة باتفاقية إعادة تأمين.

rules.title: Participant risk money goes to retakaful only
rules.instrument: Article (42) — Federal Decree-Law No. 48 of 2023 Regulating Insurance Activities
rules.note: replaced by Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 from 16 September 2025, with a transition to 16 September 2026
rules.clause: Article (42), read with the takaful regulations: the class entrusted must be carried by the counterparty, and a takaful operator's participant risk fund may only be protected by retakaful.
rules.requirement: A takaful window cedes only to a retakaful operator or a Shariah-compliant retakaful window. Participant risk money never enters a conventional pool — a breach is refused at the register, not corrected afterwards.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز لصندوق مخاطر المشتركين في شركة تكافل أن يعيد التأمين إلا لدى معيد تكافل، ولا يجوز تحويل أموال المخاطر للمشتركين إلى صندوق تقليدي.

rules.title: A free-zone company reinsures, and does nothing else outside the zone
rules.instrument: Article (42) — Federal Decree-Law No. 48 of 2023 Regulating Insurance Activities
rules.note: replaced by Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 from 16 September 2025, with a transition to 16 September 2026
rules.clause: Article (64): insurance companies licensed to operate in the financial free zones may not carry out any activity outside such zones in the State, except for reinsurance.
rules.requirement: A free-zone counterparty is a permitted reinsurer: the placement may stand, and the decision records the limit on what that company may do outside its zone.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز لشركات التأمين المرخصة في المناطق المالية الحرة مزاولة أي نشاط خارج تلك المناطق داخل الدولة، باستثناء إعادة التأمين.

rules.title: A foreign branch lodges the bank guarantee its licence requires
rules.instrument: Article (42) — Federal Decree-Law No. 48 of 2023 Regulating Insurance Activities
rules.note: replaced by Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 from 16 September 2025, with a transition to 16 September 2026

body.limitation: The registers are sealed into a canonical, checksummed snapshot with a migration path and replayed into a fresh world on restore; the outbox proves nothing was dropped between snapshots; every record remembers how far the books had got when it was made and is re-proved against the books of its own moment; and the registers carry the actions they took, so a restart puts them back by taking those actions again, checked journal for journal. Two limits are stated rather than papered over: it is not yet a database (no transactional write, no concurrent-reader isolation, no incremental streaming of the outbox), and an action that posts no journal — a cash call, a free reinstatement — is anchored by the number of journals the books held when it happened, which places it in the right window but cannot order two such actions that land inside the same journal.

rules.title: Reinsure only with a company licensed to carry the class
rules.instrument: Article (42) — Federal Decree-Law No. 48 of 2023 Regulating Insurance Activities
rules.note: replaced by Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 from 16 September 2025, with a transition to 16 September 2026
rules.clause: Article (42): The Company may not reinsure with another company unless the other company is licensed to carry out the insurance type entrusted to reinsure it.
rules.requirement: The counterparty must be licensed for the class of business ceded — a UAE licence, or a home-state licence naming the class for a reinsurer abroad. A UAE carrier may reinsure inside or outside the State, but never with an unlicensed company.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز للشركة أن تعيد التأمين لدى شركة أخرى ما لم تكن تلك الشركة مرخصة لمزاولة نوع التأمين المطلوب إعادة تأمينه.

rules.title: A counterparty at or above the rating floor, or board diligence on file
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: Article (18): acceptance of reinsurance business is conditional on the reinsurer meeting the classification stipulated, and business exceeding retention must be covered with reinsurers who have that classification, subject to the stated exceptions.
rules.requirement: A reinsurance counterparty should hold a financial strength rating of BBB (S&P) or equivalent — Baa2 or better — or, if it does not, the placement needs documented board-level due diligence before it is bound.
rules.requirementAr: يُشترط في شركة إعادة التأمين الحصول على تصنيف مالي لا يقل عن BBB أو ما يعادله، وإلا وجب توثيق العناية الواجبة على مستوى مجلس الإدارة.

rules.title: Recoverables count as admissible assets only at or above the floor
rules.instrument: Minimum capital requirement — CBUAE financial regulations — capital, assets and technical provisions
rules.clause: Assets available to meet insurance liabilities may include reinsurance recoverables where the reinsurer is rated BBB or better.
rules.requirement: Money due from a counterparty below the floor is not an admissible asset: the return must show the recoverable without credit for it, and the solvency position must be read with that in mind.
rules.requirementAr: لا تُعد المبالغ المستحقة من معيد تأمين دون التصنيف المطلوب أصولاً مقبولة، ويجب بيانها دون احتساب رصيد لها.

rules.title: Every cession sits inside the board-approved retention and reinsurance plan
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: The company shall prepare a three-year plan concerning retention and reinsurance for each type and class, approve it at the board, and review it annually during the three months before each year, covering retention and treaty limits, treaty types and facultative cessions.
rules.requirement: A cession must be permitted by the plan the board approved, and the plan must have been reviewed inside the year before the placement. A cession outside the plan is refused; a plan whose review window has passed is escalated.
rules.requirementAr: يجب أن تكون إعادة التأمين ضمن الخطة المعتمدة من مجلس الإدارة، وأن تُراجع الخطة سنوياً خلال الأشهر الثلاثة السابقة لكل سنة.
evidence: board minute of the annual review

rules.title: A foreign branch files its head-office reinsurance certificate every year
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: A foreign insurance company operating in the State through a branch shall annually submit a certified certificate from its head office supporting that the business subscribed within the State and exceeding its retention is covered by reinsurance with reinsurers who have the classification stipulated in Article (18).
rules.requirement: Where the counterparty is the branch of a foreign company, its annual certified certificate must be on file and no more than twelve months old.
rules.requirementAr: على فرع شركة التأمين الأجنبية العاملة في الدولة أن يقدم سنوياً شهادة معتمدة من المركز الرئيسي تفيد بأن الأعمال التي تتجاوز حد الاحتفاظ مغطاة لدى معيدي تأمين حاصلين على التصنيف المطلوب.

rules.title: Accepting treaty reinsurance needs approval and capital
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: Article (39): in order to accept the treaty reinsurance business, the insurance company established in the State is required to obtain approval from the Director General, and the minimum subscribed and paid-up capital of the company shall not be less than AED 350,000,000.
rules.requirement: Inward treaty business may only be accepted with the Director General's approval, articles that authorise accepting reinsurance, and at least AED 350,000,000 of subscribed and paid-up capital.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز قبول أعمال إعادة التأمين الاتفاقي إلا بعد الحصول على موافقة المدير العام، وبألا يقل رأس المال المكتتب المدفوع عن 350,000,000 درهم.

rules.title: Facultative acceptance only within retention or under a treaty
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: Article (38): the accepted liabilities shall be either within the company's retention or exceeding it, in which case the company must have a reinsurance treaty that protects the surplus and contains a provision allowing it to accept facultative reinsurance within determined limits; re-ceding that surplus facultatively needs the prior approval of the ceding company.
rules.requirement: Facultative business may be accepted only inside the retention or under a treaty that protects the surplus and permits facultative acceptance; passing the surplus on needs the ceding company's prior approval.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز قبول أعمال إعادة التأمين الاختياري إلا في حدود حد الاحتفاظ أو في وجود اتفاقية تحمي الفائض وتجيز القبول، مع الحصول على موافقة مسبقة من الشركة المتنازلة عند إعادة التنازل.

rules.title: A tender is only offered with a leading reinsurer behind the surplus
rules.instrument: Article (18) — CBUAE reinsurance regulations (Insurance Authority Board Decision No. 23 of 2019, carried into the CBUAE rulebook)
rules.note: Article (18) sets the classification requirement for reinsurers; Articles (31), (38) and (39) are cited by the rules that use them
rules.clause: Article (31): the company shall obtain approval, before submitting its offer, from a leading reinsurer that meets the conditions stipulated in Article (18), where the tender's cover is one for which the company has no reinsurance treaty covering the surplus above its retention.
rules.requirement: Where a tender is not covered by treaty, written approval from a leading reinsurer that meets the classification requirement must be on file before the offer goes in.
rules.requirementAr: يجب الحصول على موافقة من معيد تأمين رائد يستوفي شروط المادة (18) قبل تقديم العرض إذا لم تكن تغطية المناقصة مشمولة باتفاقية إعادة تأمين.

rules.title: Participant risk money goes to retakaful only
rules.instrument: Article (42) — Federal Decree-Law No. 48 of 2023 Regulating Insurance Activities
rules.note: replaced by Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 from 16 September 2025, with a transition to 16 September 2026
rules.clause: Article (42), read with the takaful regulations: the class entrusted must be carried by the counterparty, and a takaful operator's participant risk fund may only be protected by retakaful.
rules.requirement: A takaful window cedes only to a retakaful operator or a Shariah-compliant retakaful window. Participant risk money never enters a conventional pool — a breach is refused at the register, not corrected afterwards.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز لصندوق مخاطر المشتركين في شركة تكافل أن يعيد التأمين إلا لدى معيد تكافل، ولا يجوز تحويل أموال المخاطر للمشتركين إلى صندوق تقليدي.

rules.title: A free-zone company reinsures, and does nothing else outside the zone
rules.instrument: Article (42) — Federal Decree-Law No. 48 of 2023 Regulating Insurance Activities
rules.note: replaced by Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 from 16 September 2025, with a transition to 16 September 2026
rules.clause: Article (64): insurance companies licensed to operate in the financial free zones may not carry out any activity outside such zones in the State, except for reinsurance.
rules.requirement: A free-zone counterparty is a permitted reinsurer: the placement may stand, and the decision records the limit on what that company may do outside its zone.
rules.requirementAr: لا يجوز لشركات التأمين المرخصة في المناطق المالية الحرة مزاولة أي نشاط خارج تلك المناطق داخل الدولة، باستثناء إعادة التأمين.

rules.title: A foreign branch lodges the bank guarantee its licence requires
rules.instrument: Article (42) — Federal Decree-Law No. 48 of 2023 Regulating Insurance Activities
rules.note: replaced by Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 from 16 September 2025, with a transition to 16 September 2026
rules.clause: Article (50): the foreign insurance company's branch shall submit an irrevocable bank guarantee in favour of the CBUAE of not less than AED 100,000,000 where it carries on insurance activity, and not less than AED 250,000,000 where it carries on reinsurance activity.
rules.requirement: Where the counterparty is a foreign branch writing reinsurance, an irrevocable bank guarantee of at least AED 250,000,000 (AED 100,000,000 for insurance) must be lodged with the CBUAE.
rules.requirementAr: يقدم فرع شركة التأمين الأجنبية ضماناً مصرفياً غير قابل للإلغاء لصالح المصرف المركزي لا يقل عن 100,000,000 درهم لمزاولة التأمين و250,000,000 درهم لمزاولة إعادة التأمين.

rules.title: UAE risk insured at home, protected anywhere
rules.instrument: Article (82) — Federal Decree-Law No. 6 of 2025 on the Central Bank, the Regulation of Financial Institutions and Activities, and Insurance Business
rules.note: consolidates the insurance law into the CBUAE mandate; the reinsurance freedoms and controls of the 2023 law are carried forward

stages.title: Customer onboarding & identity verification
stages.purpose: Create the golden record from a verified identity document, in both languages, with the customer’s consent to process their data.
stages.regulatoryBasis: KYC / CBUAE customer identification: a verified identity document and a recorded consent before any sale.

fields.label: Name (Arabic)

fields.label: Why the document was keyed manually
fields.hint: Manual entry without a chip or government read needs a reason on file.

stages.title: Customer 360 profile, consent & duplicate check
stages.purpose: Confirm the contact details, capture the consent scopes actually needed, check the register for a duplicate of this human being, and record tax residence.
stages.regulatoryBasis: Data-protection and FATCA/CRS: purpose-limited consent, in-country residency of customer data, and tax residence on file.

fields.label: Contact details confirmed with the customer
Register searched for a duplicate customer
What the possible duplicate turned out to be
fields.hint: A match has to be resolved, not ignored: either two different people, or one record merged into the other.

fields.label: Why the match is not the same customer

fields.hint: e.g. customer.exists, customer.name, customer.contact, customer.holdings, marketing

fields.label: Where this customer’s data is processed

stages.title: Needs-analysis questionnaire
stages.purpose: Ask the questions the country’s pack requires, and derive the protection gap and the premium the customer can actually afford.
stages.regulatoryBasis: AE and MY packs: no life, medical, unit-linked or travel sale before a documented needs analysis with an identifier.

fields.label: Country whose pack governs this sale
Questionnaire answers
fields.hint: Every mandatory question must be answered before a product may be recommended.

fields.label: Customer agrees to the needs-analysis attestation

stages.title: Product / item recommendation list
stages.purpose: Rank the catalogue against the evaluated need, show the customer the alternatives on the same axes, and record which product they chose.
stages.regulatoryBasis: Suitability and comparison disclosure: the recommendation must answer the stated objective and the alternatives must be presented.

fields.label: Product selected from the recommendation list
Alternative products were presented and discussed
Why this product answers the need

stages.title: Coverage & premium calculation
stages.purpose: Set the sum assured, term and payment frequency, price the standard premium from the rate table, and test it against what the customer can afford.
stages.regulatoryBasis: Illustration rules and financial underwriting: the sum assured is capped by income, and the premium must sit inside the affordability ceiling.
produces: Standard premium from the rate table

stages.title: Occupational & medical loadings
stages.purpose: Apply the occupational debit and every medical, build, pursuit and family-history loading from the manual, itemised in basis points and money.
stages.regulatoryBasis: Underwriting manual: a loaded premium must be itemised, and any loading given away must carry a named authoriser.

fields.label: Declared medical conditions
fields.hint: Codes from the medical manual, e.g. diabetes-type-2, hypertension-controlled

fields.label: Hazardous pursuits
fields.hint: e.g. scuba-diving, motor-racing, mountaineering-above-6000m

fields.label: Family history
fields.hint: e.g. early-cardiac-death, early-cancer-death

fields.label: Customer told about the loading and the exclusions

stages.title: Additional riders (with or without loading)
stages.purpose: Attach the riders the need calls for, price each one, and record the authority for any rider attached without its loading.
stages.regulatoryBasis: Product terms and underwriting authority: a waiver of loading is a decision with a name against it.

fields.label: Riders considered with the customer
fields.hint: Recording "none needed" is a decision; leaving the section blank is not.

fields.label: Riders attached
fields.hint: Codes from the rider catalogue; leave empty if the base cover is enough

fields.label: Customer accepts the rider terms and their cost

stages.title: Medical requirements
stages.purpose: Work out what this risk has to prove, order it, receive it, and have a human review it — or record a named waiver.
stages.regulatoryBasis: Evidence bands in the product manual: no acceptance without the evidence the band requires, unless a person waives it in writing.

fields.label: Requirements ordered from the customer / clinic
Results received
fields.hint: One entry per requirement: label, status (ordered/received/reviewed/waived), date, reviewer

stages.title: Fund investment selection & allocation
stages.purpose: Choose the funds and their weights from the live NAV list, split the first contribution exactly, and test the mix against the customer’s risk appetite.
stages.regulatoryBasis: Unit-linked disclosure: the allocation the customer signs is the allocation that is invested, and a Shariah arrangement may only hold screened funds.
produces: Units to be allocated at the next valuation

fields.label: Fund weights
fields.hint: Fund id and percentage; the weights must total exactly 100%

fields.label: Customer acknowledges where the mix sits against their stated appetite
Customer told which valuation date the units will be bought at

stages.title: Beneficiary details
stages.purpose: Record who receives the proceeds and in what shares, with a guardian for any minor, and confirm the designation with the customer.
stages.regulatoryBasis: Policy terms: primary shares must total 100%, and a claim to a minor without a guardian cannot be settled.

fields.label: Beneficiaries and shares
fields.hint: Name, relationship, share %, primary or contingent, date of birth, guardian for a minor

stages.title: Underwriting & medical questionnaire review
stages.purpose: Review and update the medical questionnaire against the evidence on file, then take the underwriting decision under the right authority.
stages.regulatoryBasis: Authority matrix: an AI agent may accept or rate inside its limit and may never decline; declines and over-limit cases go to a named human.

fields.label: Medical questionnaire reviewed against the evidence
Decision taken by an AI agent inside its straight-through limit

stages.title: Quotation generation (PDF) & email to customer
stages.purpose: Assemble the quotation document with its itemised loadings, riders, allocation and mandated wording, write it as a PDF, and send it to the customer.
stages.regulatoryBasis: Disclosure: the customer must receive the terms, the illustration wording and the free-look period before paying.

fields.label: Email the PDF to the customer

stages.title: Customer review, cooling-off & sign-off
stages.purpose: Give the customer the free-look position in writing, take their signature inside the validity window, and hand the case to buy-online.
stages.regulatoryBasis: Free-look: the cooling-off period must be disclosed and the acceptance must fall inside the quotation’s validity.

stages.title: Buy online — payment options & capture
stages.purpose: Take the first payment by whichever of the six methods the customer chooses, prove it, and reconcile it against the amount due.
stages.regulatoryBasis: Money-in controls: no policy is issued on an uncleared transfer, card data is never stored, and a BNPL provider fee is disclosed.
produces: Handling cost and net to insurer

fields.label: Card number
fields.hint: Validated and reduced to its last four digits; never stored.

stages.title: Underwriting route & binding authority
stages.purpose: Decide who binds the risk: straight through, an in-house underwriter, a senior signature, a freelance underwriter hired to meet the promise, or the reinsurer’s underwriter first.
stages.regulatoryBasis: Binding authority and reinsurance: a case at or above the facultative threshold is offered to the reinsurer before issue, not after.

fields.label: Freelance underwriter engaged for this case
Treaty the risk is offered under

stages.title: Policy conversion & issuance
stages.purpose: Turn the decided proposal into a policy, receipt the first payment into the chosen funds, and allocate the units at the published valuation.
stages.regulatoryBasis: Issue controls: a policy may only be created on an accepted decision with cleared money and a signed allocation.
produces: Units allocated at the dealing valuation

fields.label: Convert the proposal into a policy
Fund the first contribution is invested in

stages.title: Funds allocation & management in force
stages.purpose: Keep the invested mix where the customer signed it: measure drift against the target weights, and rebalance, switch or top up when it moves.
stages.regulatoryBasis: Stewardship and dealing rules: changes are priced at the published valuation on the dealing day the instruction falls in.

fields.label: Allocation reviewed against the signed targets
What was done, or why nothing was needed

stages.title: Investment allocations & progress
stages.purpose: Show the customer what their money did: contributions, current value, gain or loss, drift, and the date of the next review.
stages.regulatoryBasis: Illustration honesty: progress is measured at published valuations with the disclaimer that values may fall as well as rise.

stages.title: Servicing: alterations & claims
stages.purpose: Hand the policy to servicing: what may be altered without a financial review, what needs one, and how a claim is registered and decided.
stages.regulatoryBasis: Policy administration: every alteration and claim decision is auditable, with the reason and the authority recorded.

questionnaire.label: Country of residence
questionnaire.why: Determines which regulatory pack governs the sale and whether an exception approval is needed.

questionnaire.label: How many people depend on your income?
questionnaire.why: Drives how many years of income the cover has to replace.

questionnaire.label: Gross annual income
questionnaire.why: Sets the affordability ceiling and the financial-underwriting cap on sum assured.

questionnaire.label: Sum assured already in force elsewhere
questionnaire.why: Existing cover is deducted from the need — recommending it again is mis-selling.

questionnaire.label: Outstanding mortgage or other debt to cover
questionnaire.why: Debt cover is a separate component of the protection need.

questionnaire.label: What can you afford to pay each year?
questionnaire.why: A recommendation the customer cannot pay is not a recommendation.

questionnaire.label: Main objective for this cover
questionnaire.why: The objective, not the product, is what the recommendation has to answer.

questionnaire.label: Investment risk appetite
questionnaire.why: Decides whether an investment-linked product may be recommended at all.

questionnaire.label: Shariah-compliant arrangement preferred
questionnaire.why: A takaful window may only be recommended to a customer who has asked for it or been offered it explicitly.

questionnaire.label: Your age
questionnaire.why: Entry-age limits, and the term the cover can actually run to.

questionnaire.label: Do you smoke?
questionnaire.why: Feeds the medical questionnaire and the loading that follows it.

questionnaire.label: Any diagnosed medical conditions?
questionnaire.why: A "yes" opens the medical requirements stage; it must never be skipped to speed up a sale.

questionnaire.label: Occupation class
questionnaire.why: Occupational loading is applied before the quotation is generated.

paymentMethods.label: Cash at the counter

paymentMethods.label: Credit card (Visa, Mastercard)
paymentMethods.note: Strong customer authentication required; the merchant fee is borne by the insurer, never added to the customer premium.

paymentMethods.label: Debit card (Visa, Mastercard)
paymentMethods.note: Funds leave the customer account immediately; settlement to the insurer follows the card scheme cycle.

paymentMethods.label: Bank transfer (IBAN)
paymentMethods.note: Captured as pending until the bank statement confirms the credit; the payment reference must match the quotation.

paymentMethods.label: Buy now, pay later

paymentMethods.label: Deposit in branch / cheque
paymentMethods.note: A deposit slip or cheque is held against the quotation until it clears; a cheque that bounces reverses the receipt.

body.limitation: The registers are sealed into a canonical, checksummed snapshot with a migration path and replayed into a fresh world on restore; the outbox proves nothing was dropped between snapshots; every record remembers how far the books had got when it was made and is re-proved against the books of its own moment; and the registers carry the actions they took, so a restart puts them back by taking those actions again, checked journal for journal.
